excerpt: A new general purpose fixed target facility is proposed at the CERN SPS accelerator which is aimed at exploring the domain of hidden particles and make measurements with tau neutrinos.
publisher: SHiP Collaboration / CERN SPS and PS Experiments Committee (SPSC)
title: Technical Proposal: A Facility to Search for Hidden Particles (SHiP) at the CERN SPS (CERN-SPSC-2015-016)
